summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 23 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft is reportedly training salespeople to talk down OpenAI and Anthropic
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Suno snatched millions of songs from YouTube, Genius, and Deezer
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, Ars Technica, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 50 articles published in the last 24 hours
